terra.problem: The passage for “Fishermen by the fresh river” does not say that the river comes from the sanctuary. Extend it to Ezekiel 47:9–12.
The fishermen are described as standing by the shore, not beside the river. Change the title to “Fishermen along the shore.”
Words such as “strongholds,” “anointed,” and “sanctuary” may be difficult at a fifth-grade level. Use or add simpler explanations, such as “safe places,” “chosen by the LORD,” and “temple.”
